title_en: [Research on emotion recognition in electroencephalogram based on independent component analysis-recurrence plot and improved EfficientNet]
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
topics: 情感理解与情感智能；脑电情感识别；情感计算与情绪理解
abstract_zh: 为了准确捕获并有效整合脑电图信号的时空特征，以提高基于脑电图的情感识别的准确性，本文提出了一种将独立成分分析-递归图与改进的EfficientNet版本2（EfficientNetV2）相结合的新方法。首先，使用独立分量分析从脑电信号的关键通道中提取包含空间信息的独立分量。然后使用递归图将这些分量转换为二维图像，以更好地从时间信息中提取情感特征。最后，二维图像被输入到改进的 EfficientNetV2 中，该网络包含全局 at...
abstract_en: To accurately capture and effectively integrate the spatiotemporal features of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals for the purpose of improving the accuracy of EEG-based emotion recognition, this paper proposes a new method combining independent component analysis-recurrence plot with an improved EfficientNet version 2 (EfficientNetV2). First, independent component analysis is used to extract independent components containing spatial information from key channels of the EEG signals. These components are then converted into two-dimensional images using recurrence plot to better extract emotional features from the temporal information. Finally, the two-dimensional images are input into an improved EfficientNetV2, which incorporates a global attention mechanism and a triplet attention mechanism, and the emotion classification is output by the fully connected layer. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, this study conducts comparative experiments, channel selection experiments and ablation experiments based on the Shanghai Jiao Tong University Emotion Electroencephalogram Dataset (SEED). The results demonstrate that the average recognition accuracy of our method is 96.77%, which is significantly superior to existing methods, offering a novel perspective for research on EEG-based emotion recognition. 为精准捕获并有效融合脑电信号中的时空特征以提高脑电情绪识别精度，本文提出一种基于独立成分分析—递归图和改进的第2代高效能网络（EfficientNetV2）相结合的新方法。首先，采用独立成分分析从脑电信号的关键通道中提取包含空间信息的独立成分；然后，由递归图转换为二维图像以更好地提取时间信息中的情感特征；最后，将二维图像输入到引入全局注意力机制和三重注意力机制的EfficientNetV2中，由全连接层输出情感分类。为验证所提方法的有效性，本研究基于上海交通大学情绪脑电数据集（SEED）进行对比实验、通道选择实验和消融实验。研究结果显示，本文所提方法平均识别准确率为96.77%，显著优于现有其他方法，为脑电情绪识别研究提供了新的思路。.

title_zh: 基于Transformer和生理信号的老年人情绪识别研究
title_en: A Research on Emotion Recognition of the Elderly Based on Transformer and Physiological Signals
authors: Guohong Feng；Hongen Wang；Mengdi Wang；Xiao Zheng；Runze Zhang
primary_category: 情感数据集、基准与评测
topics: 脑电情感识别；脑电基础大模型；情感计算与情绪理解
abstract_zh: 针对老年人情绪识别困难以及传统机器学习模型无法有效捕捉生理信号数据之间的非线性关系等问题，提出基于脑电图（EEG）、皮电活动（EDA）和心率变异性（HRV）信号的递归映射（RM）结合视觉变换器（ViT）来识别老年人的情绪。粪甲虫优化器 (DBO) 用于优化 EEG、EDA 和 HRV 信号的变分模态分解。使用RM将优化的分解时间序列信号转换为二维图像，然后将转换后的图像信号应用到ViT中以用于情感记忆的研究...
abstract_en: Aiming at problems such as the difficulty of recognizing emotions in the elderly and the inability of traditional machine-learning models to effectively capture the nonlinear relationship between physiological signal data, a Recursive Map (RM) combined with a Vision Transformer (ViT) is proposed to recognize the emotions of the elderly based on Electroencephalogram (EEG), Electrodermal Activity (EDA), and Heart Rate Variability (HRV) signals. The Dung Beetle Optimizer (DBO) is used to optimize the variational modal decomposition of EEG, EDA, and HRV signals. The optimized decomposed time series signals are converted into two-dimensional images using RM, and then the converted image signals are applied to the ViT for the study of emotion recognition of the elderly. The pre-trained weights of ViT on the ImageNet-22k dataset are loaded into the model and retrained with the two-dimensional image data. The model is validated and compared using the test set. The research results show that the recognition accuracy of the proposed method on EEG, EDA, and HRV signals is 99.35%, 86.96%, and 97.20%, respectively. This indicates that EEG signals can better reflect the emotional problems of the elderly, followed by HRV signals, while EDA signals have poorer effects. Compared with Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes (NB), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), the recognition accuracy of the proposed method is increased by at least 9.4%, 11.13%, and 12.61%, respectively. Compared with ResNet34, EfficientNet-B0, and VGG16, it is increased by at least 1.14%, 0.54%, and 3.34%, respectively. This proves the superiority of the proposed method in emotion recognition for the elderly.

title_zh: 基于特征选择和粪甲虫优化器的采后蓝莓保质期预测的反向传播神经网络模型
title_en: A Back Propagation Neural Network Model for Postharvest Blueberry Shelf-Life Prediction Based on Feature Selection and Dung Beetle Optimizer
authors: Runze Zhang；Yujie Zhu；Zhongshen Liu；Guohong Feng；Pengfei Diao；Hongen Wang；Shenghong Fu；Shuo Lv；Chen Zhang
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
abstract_zh: (1)背景：传统的基于动力学的保质期预测模型拟合精度低，对蓝莓的预测结果不准确。因此，本研究旨在开发一种基于由粪甲虫优化器使用精英库策略和高斯分布估计策略（GDEDBO）优化的反向传播神经网络（BPNN）的蓝莓货架期预测方法； （2）方法：以“自由”蓝莓品种为研究对象，在0、4、25℃贮藏温度下测定色泽参数、失重率、腐烂率、质构参数等23项品质指标。基于最大相关最小冗余（MRMR）算法，七个关键影响因素...
abstract_en: (1) Background: Traditional kinetic-based shelf-life prediction models have low fitting accuracy and inaccurate prediction results for blueberries. Therefore, this study aimed to develop a blueberry shelf-life prediction method based on a back propagation neural network (BPNN) optimized by the dung beetle optimizer using an elite pool strategy and a Gaussian distribution estimation strategy (GDEDBO); (2) Methods: The “Liberty” blueberry cultivar was used as the research object, and 23 quality indicators, including color parameters, weight loss rate, decay rate, and texture parameters, were measured under storage temperatures of 0, 4, and 25 °C. Based on the maximum relevance minimum redundancy (MRMR) algorithm, seven key influencing factors of shelf life were selected as the input parameters of the model, and then the MRMR-GDEDBO-BPNN prediction model was established; (3) Results: the results showed that the model outperformed the baseline model at all three temperatures, with strong generalization ability, high prediction accuracy, and reliability; and (4) Conclusions: this study provided a theoretical basis for the shelf-life determination of blueberries under different storage temperatures and offered technical support for the prediction of remaining shelf life.

title_zh: 基于异构堆叠集成学习的蓝莓硬度预测营养成分模型构建
title_en: Construction of Blueberry Hardness Prediction Nutrient Content Model Based on Heterogeneous Stacking Ensemble Learning
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
abstract_zh: 摘要 为了有效控制蓝莓的贮藏品质，针对蓝莓品质检测的现状，提出了一种基于异构Stacking集成学习的蓝莓理化指标预测模型。首先，通过对蓝莓硬度、质量与维生素C、可溶性固形物含量的相关性分析，建立了基于硬度和质量一维特征的维生素C和可溶性固形物含量预测模型。其次，在硬度中加入多维特征进行维度提升，并在同一维度进行相同的研究。最后，单模Stacking集成学习的预测效果...
abstract_en: Abstract In order to effectively control the storage quality of blueberries, a prediction model between physical and chemical indicators of blueberries based on heterogeneous Stacking ensemble learning was proposed for the current situation of blueberry quality detection. Firstly, through the correlation analysis of blueberry hardness、mass with the vitamin C, and soluble solid content, a prediction model of the vitamin C and soluble solid content based on one-dimensional features of hardness and mass was established. Secondly, multi-dimensional features were added to the hardness to do the dimensional lift and the same study was carried out in the same dimension. Finally, the prediction effects of Stacking ensemble learning with a single model and the addition of multi-dimensional features were compared (The correlation coefficient and root mean square error of validation of the optimal models were 0.890、0.889 and 0.250、0.232). The results show that heterogeneous Stacking combined with the addition of multi-dimensional features has good predictive potential and provides a new way for blueberry quality detection.

title_zh: 强化杨木单板制造技术
title_en: Manufacturing Technology of Strengthened Poplar Veneers
authors: Xiao Dong Zhu；Feng Hu Wang；Jun Cao；Jian Ping Sun
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
abstract_zh: 采用苯乙烯、甲基丙烯酸甲酯、醋酸乙烯三种混合液浸泡杨木单板，得到强化杨木单板。确定最佳摩尔比为1:2:1。获得浸泡聚合工艺为压力0.4Mpa、保压时间60min、聚合温度80℃、聚合时间6h、环烷酸钴2%、氯化锌6%、偶氮二异丁腈3%。在所选水平下，高温对转化率的影响显着，其他因素对转化率的影响并不显着。
abstract_en: Three mixed liquids, Styrene, Methylmethacrylate and Vinyl acetate were used to soak poplar veneer to obtain strengthen poplar veneers. The optimal molar ratio was fixed on 1:2:1.Soaking and polymerization technology were obtained as pressure 0.4Mpa, packing time 60 minutes, polymerization temperature 80°C, polymerization time 6 hours, cobalt naphthenate 2%, zinc chloride 6%, and azobisisobutyronitrile 3%. The impact of high temperature on the conversion was significant in the chosen level, other factors on the conversion rate was not significant.
